parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Dimension: brand | sku | supplier | sales_channel | product_type | sub_sales_channel | customer_tags (nullable). customer_tags fans out — an order counts toward each of its customer's tags — and the grand total is deduplicated. customer_tags does not require attribute_id.

parameters.name: dimension_value
parameters.description: Value of the dimension to filter by (nullable)
